routine: 단어 5분(예문 소리 내어 2번) → 패턴 5분(뼈대에 내 문장 넣기) → 위를 가리고 문제 3분 → 복습 2분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

scorecard.focus: 11/7(토) 주간시험이 만들어지지 않아 채점할 시험이 없음(토요일 실행 누락 추정)
scorecard.change: 학습설정 변경 없음. 11/14(토) 시험은 정상 출제

review.title: 복습 (11/09·11/06 표현 + 오답 2개), 영어로 먼저 써 보기

items.prompt: 책임지고 살피다, 관리·감독하다 — be in charge of checking 대신

items.answer: ~ will take over ~, while you continue to ~.
To clarify, I'm asking about ~, not just ~.

items.prompt: 신속한, 즉각적인: Thank you for your ____ reply.

cover_practice.prompt: 기한이 지난: The fire extinguisher check is two weeks o______.
서로 맞지 않는: The headcount in the report is i___________ with the attendance data.
범위: Please write the s____ of work in the PR.
제외하다: Please e______ resigned workers from the list.
이번 주 금요일까지 못 끝내면, 이유와 끝낼 수 있는 날짜를 알려 주세요. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: If you cannot finish it by this Friday, please let me know the reason and the date you can finish.

cover_practice.prompt: 계약서에는 점검이 월 1회라고 되어 있는 반면, 보고서에는 분기 1회라고 되어 있습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: The contract says the check is monthly, whereas the report says it is quarterly.

words.meaning: 기한이 지난 — was due on ~, but not done 대신
words.example: No. 1 and No. 3 are now overdue, so please finish them today.
words.collocations: two days overdue / an overdue payment

words.meaning: 서로 맞지 않는, 앞뒤가 다른 — do not match 대신
words.example: Sections 4.1.3 and 4.2.5 are inconsistent about who buys the raw materials.

words.meaning: (작업·견적의) 범위 — the same work items 대신
words.example: Please ask all three companies to quote the same scope.
words.collocations: scope of work / out of scope

words.meaning: 빼다, 제외하다 — do not include 대신
words.example: The current contractor is doing our lug work, so please exclude them.
words.collocations: exclude A from B / excluding VAT

patterns.pattern: If you cannot ~, please let me know the reason and the date you can ~.
patterns.meaning: ~를 못 하면 이유와 끝낼 수 있는 날짜를 알려 주세요 (기한을 넘긴 직원에게 마지막으로 확인할 때)
patterns.skeleton: If you cannot + [동사원형], please let me know the reason and the date you can + [동사원형]
patterns.email: If you cannot finish No. 2 by Nov 10, please let me know the reason and the date you can finish.
patterns.spoken: If not, tell me why and when.

patterns.meaning: A에는 ~라고 되어 있는 반면, B에는 ~라고 되어 있습니다 (but ..., so they do not match 대신, 두 문서가 다를 때)
patterns.email: Section 4.1.3 says we pay for raw materials, whereas Section 4.2.5 says customers supply them.
patterns.spoken: This page says one thing, that page says another.

patterns.meaning: ~하는 대신 ~해 주세요 (일하는 방법을 바꿔 달라고 할 때)
patterns.email: Instead of saving the files on your PC, please keep them in the shared folder.
patterns.spoken: Don't keep it on your PC, use the shared folder.
